reports.title: IDACORP, Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results, Increases Earnings Guidance Range

lines: IDACORP is increasing its previously reported full-year 2026 earnings guidance to the range of $6.40 to $6.50 per diluted share, with the expectation that Idaho Power will use less than $10 million of additional tax credits available under the Idaho regulatory mechanism in 2026.
